verified.alias_source: The applicant strings below were read from the official openFDA /device/510k.json endpoint on 2026-11-17, filtered to the ICU monitoring product codes in config/radar/topics.json (5,745 records, decision dates 1976-07-19..2026-10-26).
verified.alias_note: Each alias is a real string that the source published. Confidence expresses identity certainty of the alias mapping only. It never expresses technical capability.
cannot_do: An applicant field is a record claim by the submitter, not proof of current manufacture or ownership.
A subsidiary listed under a parent is an organisational relation, not evidence about the parent's product portfolio.
A publication affiliation is never resolved into a product manufacturer.
